description: Evaluation scenarios for the audio-pipeline-overview skill (stage routing, the two modes, approval gates, and resume).

scenarios.query: We're building a 2D platformer and the player just got a dash. Auto mode: give me the dash sound effect.
expected_behavior: Recognises auto mode and does NOT ask the user any clarifying questions about mood, duration, loop or backend
Infers the requirement from the conversation (se, short one-shot, no loop, Stable Audio 3 small-sfx) and states the inference in one line before running
Runs the stages in order: init_asset.py, generate_sa3.py with 1 candidate, post_process.py, review_asset.py
Does not stop for approval and does not call approve_asset.py --approve on the user's behalf; the candidate is selected but stays unapproved
Reports the output paths and the review verdict, and if the review fails, adjusts seed or prompt and regenerates at most twice more before reporting honestly

scenarios.query: I want a town theme for the game, and I want to pick the take myself. Set it up properly.
expected_behavior: Recognises this as manual mode and elicits the requirement first: purpose and scene, mood or genre, duration, loop, vocals, reference track (AskUserQuestion if available, otherwise plain questions, then waits for the reply)
Initializes with init_asset.py --mode manual and generates 3 candidates on ACE-Step
Presents each candidate with its file path, its leading and trailing silence figures (and loopViable when false), and a one-line description of its character, then waits for the user's choice
Does not run post_process.py before the user has chosen, and explains that the post stage refuses until the choice is approved
Records the choice with approve_asset.py <slug> --select generate/cand-NN.wav --approve, then runs the post and review stages and confirms the result with the user

scenarios.query: The boss theme asset failed partway through yesterday. Pick it back up.
expected_behavior: Reads audio-pipeline-output/<slug>/pipeline.json before doing anything and reports the current stage statuses
Resumes from the first stage whose status is pending or failed instead of restarting the asset from the requirement stage
Uses stages.<stage>.failureKind (and stages.review.checks when the review failed) to explain what went wrong, rather than guessing
Respects the manifest's mode when resuming: manual mode still needs the approval gate, auto mode does not
Does not re-run an already completed stage or overwrite existing candidates, and notes that re-generating appends new candidate files instead of replacing them

scenarios.query: Just run the post stage on the town theme, I'm in a hurry.
expected_behavior: Checks the manifest mode, and for a manual-mode asset explains that post_process.py refuses until stages.generate is approved
Points the user at approve_asset.py (or /audio-asset-pipeline:approve) with the candidate listing rather than editing pipeline.json by hand to set approved: true
Does not switch the asset to auto mode, pass a flag, or otherwise work around the gate to save time
Offers the legitimate shortcut instead: play the candidates now, or re-create the asset in auto mode if approval is genuinely not wanted

scenarios.query: Give me an ending theme with proper sung vocals, and I need it in the next few minutes.
expected_behavior: Routes sung vocals to generate_minimax.py per the backend routing table
States the MiniMax-Music3 license obligation (the product UI must display 'MiniMax-Music3') before starting the run, not afterwards

Warns that the render takes over half an hour of GPU time per candidate (measured: 36 minutes for 75 s of music on a 12 GB card) plus a 27 GB first-run download, so the stated deadline is not achievable
Offers the honest alternative: an ACE-Step vocal take in seconds, or accepting the wait
Runs doctor.py --stack minimax before committing to the long run
